scope.summary: Author the extremity and frame detail channels per Section 13.17 (BK-17.3, TAI-BK-050), closing OBR-004's small-hands archetype axis: hand_scale and foot_scale (Skeletal, per-bone scale through the 13.18 lane) plus neck_girth and arm_girth (Tissue) — small hands simultaneously with huge breasts is part of the operator's canonical archetype (a).
acceptance_criteria: hand_scale and foot_scale registered kind Skeletal (hand_l/r, foot_l/r bone sets with declared child propagation); neck_girth and arm_girth registered kind Tissue over neck and arm masks.
hand_scale at min leaves finger articulation intact: joint re-derivation keeps knuckle joints proportionally placed (13.18 hook), asserted by a joint-position ratio test at 50% scale.
Full-range sweeps of all four channels pass BODY_DECOUPLE_VALID (zero displacement outside their masks; arm_girth does not touch hand masks).
Archetype (a) extremity sample: hand_scale min + breast_volume 3.0 + shoulder_frame_width min evaluates artifact-free.
All channels API-addressable; skeletal channels document propagation semantics in their registry rows.
scope.risk_if_missed: Small hands are a named operator archetype axis; naive uniform hand scaling breaks knuckle placement and skinning, forcing per-body rig fixes — the class of manual Adjust-Rigging work BodyKit's automatic re-derivation exists to eliminate.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > BodyKit shape channels and measurements

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT emits typed diagnostics through its owning command or job and inherits retention, health, and projection behavior from the shared diagnostics substrate.
The owning native shell or scheduled job supplies Palmistry coverage; this MT must preserve operation identity and recovery handles.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Separate control independence from declared feathered deformation support, skeletal propagation, physical response, and explicit coupling.
Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.
